name: M8.MixedNonproduct.mixed_obstruction
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 7 ≤ N → (M7.Supports.indicator (M8.MixedFamily.left N),M7.Supports.indicator (M8.MixedFamily.right N)) ∈ M8.MixedNonproduct.Cycles (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N) ∧ (0,0) ∈ M8.MixedNonproduct.Cycles (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N) ∧ (M7.Supports.indicator (M8.MixedFamily.left N),0) ∉ M8.MixedNonproduct.Cycles (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N)
guidance:
Original M8 §8 third family's distinct cycle-space nonproduct property, not the separated-direction property. Cycles is literal physical syndrome kernel on unflattened two-block words. Product means exactly some U×V. product_rectangular: any set of pairs is product iff all cross combinations stay in it; use first/second projections as U,V, including empty case. word_action: this explicit translateWord/multiplyWord/exchange composition flattens to M7.Transport.Xmap; use Flatten.flatten_left/right, RecipeIsometries.lift and Spaces.cycle_words_iff with Transport.action_isometry for exact cycle equivalence and bijection. Alternatively accepted multiplied_syndrome, translated_syndrome, exchange_laws, shift_laws/multiply_laws give the word statements directly. product_action: rectangularity is preserved by independent block bijections and block exchange. For reverse implication apply the forward argument to inverse g and Action.act_inverse. In crossed pair images, split g.exchange; nonexchange maps (z.1,t.2) to crossed images, exchange uses (t.1,z.2). No arbitrary Clifford/tensor equivalence. mixed_obstruction: (a,b) is a cycle from conv_comm and characteristic2, zero is a cycle; (a,0) has syndrome conv b a, which is nonzero. Can evaluate coordinate0 using supports{0,1}/{0,2} and N≥7, or use Coordinates.encode_conv/encode_polynomial and MixedFamily.literal_polynomials/algebra/nontrivial to get image(a*b) nonzero since degree3<N (modulus_monic_degree and AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero). Exact M6.ActualCSS is not needed; no mixed distance goal. Finally product_rectangular plus paired cycle and zero would force excluded (a,0), then product_action proves the entire permitted recipe orbit is nonproduct. Return tactic lines only.
import M8MixedFamilyAccepted
namespace M8.MixedNonproduct
noncomputable def Cycles {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) : Set (M6.Physical.Word N) :=
  {z | M6.Physical.syndrome N (M7.Supports.indicator c.1) (M7.Supports.indicator c.2) z = 0}
def Product {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) : Prop :=
  ∃ U V : Set (M6.Physical.Block N), Cycles c = U ×ˢ V
def wordAction {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (g : M7.Action.Record N) (z : M6.Physical.Word N) :=
  M6.RecipeIsometries.translateWord N g.leftShift g.rightShift
    (M6.RecipeIsometries.multiplyWord N g.unit (if g.exchange then M6.RecipeIsometries.exchange N z else z))
end M8.MixedNonproduct
